sources.title: Cuttle-fish-my/Rethinking-CFG-OPD-ckpts · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Rethinking CFG in On-Policy Distillation — checkpoints LoRA adapters from our study of classifier-free guidance in on-policy distillation (OPD). One folder per experimental setting, named as the paper names it. Every adapter is a LoRA over a frozen base model, so a checkpoint is tens of MB rather than the full backbone.
